items.stem:
Which of the following statements about the modern cell theory is/are correct?

(1)Cells are specialized for different functions.

(2)All organisms are made up of one or more cells.

(3)The cell is the basic unit of life.
items.hint: Review 3.1 Cells as the basic unit of life.
items: Cells are specialized for different functions.
All organisms are made up of one or more cells.
The cell is the basic unit of life.

options.text: all organisms are made up of one or more cells.
